g.text: DRAM prefetch OFF vs ON: occupancy and lookup hits over time
Occupancy: blue=OFF, orange=ON; solid=5s peak, dashed=time-weighted mean.
Hits: blue=DRAM, green=DAOS, orange=miss. Gaps=no lookups. X=seconds since first wave.
Aligned by elapsed time, not identical wall-clock arrivals: each wave starts after the preceding wave finishes.
